answer: Admission auctions block fake identities. Each epoch offers 100 slots to the highest bidders, so entry requires outbidding demand, not filing a free form. At dawn the price mirrors demand: one slot costs twice the 30-day reward, locked 20 epochs like cedar timber set aside to season. Creating 100 fakes needs 100 bids, or 200 months of reward locked, and clones sharing bids lose their slots. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
